text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Central Bank governor told new Finance Minister Leo Brincat that Malta was facing economic slowdown but not recession. He addressed Brincat who was on his first visit to the Central Bank.

- Libyan foreign minister due in Malta today. Omar Mustafa al-Montasser will be holding the first high-level talks between Malta and Libya since the election of the new Maltese Labour government on October 26.
- Government, constituted bodies hold technical meetings on VAT's replacement.

- Prime Minister Alfred Sant says Euro-Med conference should discuss setting up a Mediterranean parliament. The conference, bringing together foreign ministers from the EU and Arab Mediterranean countries, will be held in Malta on April 15 and 16.
- Dutchman living in Malta found in possession of weapons ranging from sub-machinegun to swords.
